tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gnam chos thugs gter las klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po'i gsol kha bzhugs so//

ྈྈ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hūm̐: mi mgon dkar po'i gsol mchod ni: a kā ro sa byin gyis brlab: hūm̐: klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni: smar khams sgang sogs bzhugs gnas nas: bdag gis spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas dgyes par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ nā ga rā tsa a ti sa ma ya dzaḥdza: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni: sku mdog dkar gsal mdzes pa'i gzugs: sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can: sku smad gser sbrul ser po 'khyil: phyag gnyis thal sbyar bum pa 'dzin: khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: klu sman dar zab sna tshogs dang: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang: bdud rtsi sman dang gtor ma 'bul: mthun rdzas du mas mnyes gyur cig: khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni: char chu dus su 'beb pa dang: lo 'bru rtag tu legs pa dang: phyugs kyi god kha med par mdzod: khyad par bdag cag dpon slob la: dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol: mdor na yid la bsam tshad kun: 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: ma thogs bcol pa'iphrin las mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: ྈྈྈ ྈྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum gser 'phyang gi lo 'khrig pa'i khyim gyi dkar po'i phyogs kyi aṣ+ṭa'i nyin 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa klu mi mgon dkar po nyid dngos su byon nas gsol mchod 'di ltar gyis zhes dngos su smras so/// / ༄༅// bdag gis sems can kun don du// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs dgos pas// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*// sems can dbul phongs sel ba la// longs spyod chen po med thabs med// rtse gcig sgrub pa byed pa la'ang*// mthun rkyen sgrub rgyags 'dzom dgos pas// nor lha mi mgon dkar po 'di// bsgrub par bya 'o bsam pa yi// sems bskyed bzang pos kun bslang ste//

yi dam lha gzhung rdzogs pa'i mjug /gnam chos klu yi las byang 'don par bya// dmigs pa'i bye brag 'di ltar ro// sgrub rdzas mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// 'o ma'i mdog can rgya mtsho ni// rgya che g.yo 'gul med pa'i dbus// rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i// gzhal med khang pa chen po'i nang*// rgyal rigs rje'u rigs bram ze'i rigs// dmangs rigs gdol pa'i klu bran gyis// 'og nas btegs pa'i steng du ni// pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad pa'i// dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// sa bon phuḥyig dkar po las// 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems mchod// klu dang sa bdag thams cad dang*// gnod sbyin nor lha'i dngos grub bsdus// 'od du zhu bas klu rgyal ni// bstod pa'i nang nas 'byung ltar bsgom/ rang nyid yi dam thugs ka nas// 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros// rgya mtsho che dang gang gā dang*// rang bzhin gar bzhugs gnas nyid nas// spyan drangs mdun bskyed nyid la thim/ /klu rgyal thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// phuḥyig dkar po'i mtha' skor du// sngags phreng g.yon du bkod pa la// bdag gi thugs las 'od 'phros pas// sngags phreng g.yas su je mgyogs 'khor/ kho yi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas// sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshig dran// sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros// 'od zer rtse las rin chen rigs// zas nor longs spyod dngos grub kyi// char pa sib sib 'bab par bsgom// 'od zer dkar po zla ba'i 'od// lta bu 'phros pas rang nyid dang*// bsrung bya'i nad gdon bar chad kun// mun par zla shar lta bur bsal// 'od zer dkar la ser mdangs can// 'phros nas tshe dang bsod nams rnams// pad+mar nyi zer phog ltar rgyas// 'od zer ser la dmar mdangs can// 'phros pas skye 'gro thams cad kun// rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus// yid la ci 'dod dngos grub kun// thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par bsgom// nā ga rā tsa a ti hūm̐:

nā ga rā tsa a ti sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: g.yas su blon po dung skyong dang*// g.yon du btsun mo 'od ldan ma// de rgyab 'dab brgyad klu chen brgyad// steng du sprin gyi bla bre can// thams cad zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs// thal mo sbyar nas bdag nyid la// gus shing bka' nyan gsung sdod bsgom// nyin re thun re'am bzhi 'am drug /gnam chos gzhung gi las byang gtang*// spro na skong gsol sbyar ba 'o// oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga 'dus/ nā ga dhu/ nā ga sarba/ he long he long*/ nā ga 'dus 'dus/ shān+tiṃ 'dus/ puṣ+ṭiṃ 'dus/ nā ga dhe ba sarba sid+dhi sa ma ya/ nā ga 'dus 'dus/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bang ba la 'dus/ puṣ+ṭiṃ tshe dang bsod nams la sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ spu tse spu tse nā ga spu tse/ spu ta spu ta nā ga spu ta/ phi shang phi shang nā ga phi shang*/ nā ga sid+dhi 'ub 'ub/ rug rug si ti sdus sdus hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga le nā ga le/ nā ga dung dung nā ga sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga pra ti rā dza sa ma ya sid+dhi 'dus 'dus/ zhes bzla/ rjes rim spyi dang mthun/ a rā gas so/// / 1$0000250༄༅// gnam chos kyi lhan thabs klu mi mgon dkar po'i skong gsol g.yang skyabs sbrags ma yod lags/ 1$0000300na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ mi mgon dkar po'i skong gsol dang*// g.yang skyabs sbrags ma bya ba ni// mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci 'dzom la// las byang tshar rjes gtor ma gso// a kā ro sa byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la// srog chags kun gyi gshed ma ru// mgo nag rkang gnyis mi rnams srid// thabs rnams du mas srog chags gsod// rkang gnyis mi yi gshed ma ru// klu rigs nyi shu rtsa lnga srid// klu nad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// mi rnams thams cad dmyal thag bcad// de tshe klu rnams 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi// thugs las yi ge phe gcig 'phros// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams// chos nyid rang mdangs rgya mtsho'i dbus// 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha sprul// klu rigs thams cad 'dul bar mdzad// ye shes klu bdud mgo dgu ste// dge bsnyen smyo kha'i rje bo mdzad// klu rigs rnams kyi yang rje mdzad// de tshe rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis// klu 'bum rgyud kyi ti ka gsungs// 'gro ba'i klu nad sel bar mdzad// nā ga rak+sha drag po'i sku// klu bdud 'chi bdag mgo dgu zhes// gtad khram kun gyi gnyer kha 'dzin// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad// gshin rje 'chi bdag nag por grags// rgyud dang sgrub thabs bsam mi khyab// nā ga rak+sha zhi ba'i sku// mi rnams kun gyi mgon mdzad phyir// mi mgon dkar po zhes su grags// ngo bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sems can kun gyi mgon mdzad phyir// 'jig rten lha 'dre'i tshul du bzhugs// rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul dang*// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la// srog gi snying po phul nas kyang*// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pas// klu yi mgon po dkar por grags// klu sgrub 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sogs// rig 'dzin mang pos bka' yang bsgos// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la// longs spyod dngos grub stsol bar chad// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// mang yul byams sprin lha khang dang*// 'or rngu byams pa'i srung mar bskos// bzhugs gnas smar khams lung yang bstan// rgya gar chu bo gang gā'i 'gram// bla ma dpal chen rgwa lo la// rang gzugs bstan nas sgrub thabs phul// mar mi dwags po phag gru pa// nyag ras se bo la sogs pa// sgrub brgyud bka' yi srung ma mdzad// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje la// rang gzugs dngos su bstan nas kyang*// nga la mchod bstod 'di ltar gyis// zhes gsungs gsol mchod sgrub thabs phul// gnam chos bka' yi srung ma mdzad// de ltar sngon nas da lta'i bar// gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma ste// rig 'dzin brgyud kyi srung ma yin// klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni// btsun mo blon po 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// yid las sprul pa 'o ma'i mtsho// chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i bla bre'i 'og

/rin chen gzhal yas pho brang dbus// klu rigs kun gyis btegs pa'i khri// pad dkar zla ba rgyas pa'i steng*// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzad phyir// klu yi mgon po dkar po ni// ji srid mchod pa 'bul bgyid bar// de srid dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs// mi rnams kun gyi mgon por mdzod// rang dam rang gis bcas pa dang*// rta mgrin gsang bdag pad 'byung gi /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// bdag gis bcol ba'iphrin las sgrubs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yi// dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa dang*// klu sman rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// shing rtsi me tog dar tshon dang*// mda' dar chu gnas sna tshogs rigs// phye mar bzang shing bdug spos dang*// mchod sprin 'jig rten gang ba 'bul// rin chen snod mchog rgya che bar// gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ kha dog dri ro nus par ldan// zad med zag med bde skyed pa// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas// klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni// btsun mo blon po 'khor g.yog bcas// thams cad kun la 'bul gyis bzhes// thams cad mnyes shing tshims gyur nas// klu nad thams cad zhi ba dang*// bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'phel gyur cig /oṃ nā ga rā tsa a ti hūm̐: sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi// thugs sprul klu yi mgon po ni// mi mgon dkar po gter gyi bdag /dung mdog dkar po mdzes shing 'dzum// sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can// res 'ga' sbrul mgo brgya stong ldan// zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs pa la// sbrul gyi mjug mas mi mngon dkris// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar// gter gyi bum pa bsnams pa la/ kha rgyan yid bzhin nor bus brgyan// rin chen 'bar ba'i gtsug phud can// res 'ga' phyag g.yas nor bu las// dgos 'dod char pa sil li li// g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog

/rin chen gter gyis bkang ba 'dzin// pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// sbrul mjug rtse mo 'o mtshor nub// steng na 'ja' sprin bla re 'khrigs// 'brug sgra khu 'phang shar ra ra// rma g.yang dngos grub sprin ltar 'thibs// 'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon bar chad thams cad sol// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor ni// dbyar gyi chu bzhin 'phel bar mdzod// hūm̐/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi// sprul pa khams kyi phyogs su byon// rma gnyan spom ra'i nang blon te// yab ni rma gnyan klu thog rje// yum ni mtsho rgyal steng sgron ma// de gnyis rdzu 'phrul bsdebs pa las// mi mgon dkar po mched bdun 'khrungs// dgun gsum sa dang chu la gnas// sa 'og klu yi rgyal po mdzad// klu rgyal mi mgon dkar por grags// klu chen brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor// rigs bzhi'i klu rnams pho nyar 'gyed// nag phyogs klu yi kha gnon mdzad// klu nad thams cad sel bar mdzad// klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po la// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// klu g.yang mi la dbab tu gsol// bkra shis dar rgyas che bar mdzod// mtsho dang chu la gnas pa'i tshe// mtsho rlabs mtsho bskyams chems se chem// mtsho lud rlabs phreng kyil li li// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa// klu rje thod dkar mi yi mgon// sras ni mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal// dbus gtsang khams gsum chu bdag kun// yab sras gnyis kyi 'bangs dang 'khor// sgrub brgyud srung mar zhal gyis bzhes// klu yi mgon po yab sras la// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// btsan phyug dar gsum dngos grub stsol// klu g.yang nam mkha'i char bzhin phob// dpyid gsum sa dang ri la gnas// sa drod nem nem na bun phyur// zhang blon mched bdun zhes kyang grags// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// rdo rje phur pa'i dbang yang bskur// gsang mtshan rdo rje gur mgon btags// smar khams yul lha kun gyi rje// 'or rngu byams pa'i bka' srung mdzad// gtsug lag khang gi srung ma che// klu yi mgon po mched 'khor bcas// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa yi// rma g.yang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po la// bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs// sprin phung kha char bu yug 'tshubs// ye rdzu kha char 'dab ma can// mi dkar rta dkar ri logs tsam// dbu la thang zhu dkar po can/

khams kyi bya thul zhes su grags// sum brgya drug cu'i 'khor dang bcas// sprul pa'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang*// klu yi dge bsnyen mthu bo che// mi mgon dkar po 'khor bcas la// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// mi 'phen rta hrag dngos grub stsol// mi g.yang nor g.yang 'dir khug cig /ston gsum rtsi thog bcud la 'khor// lo legs 'bru 'phel yul lha mdzod// sad ser btsa' 'bu'i kha khogs la// bang mdzod 'bru yi dngos grub stsol// lo legs skya rgyal g.yang phob cig /mi g.yang kun gyi mgon mdzad tshe// sku mdog gangs kyi ri ltar 'tsher// phyag na me tog ljon shing rgyas// myur mgyogs chu rta sngon po 'chib// bye'u sgang nas sbar cing byon// mi bu tshang nas skyed cing byon// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams// rmang po rnams ni 'phan par gyis// rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// rigs rgyud gzugs mdzes shes rab ldan// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen ni// thub bstan gnas bar 'byung 'gyur ba'i// g.yang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rin chen nor gyi lha mdzad tshe// sku mdog sngon po g.yu 'od 'bar// phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// rin chen nor gyi char pa 'beb// chibs su glang chen 'gying ba 'chib// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi g.yang phob la// dbul po rnams ni phyug par gyis// nor 'phel phyugs g.yang bstsal du gsol// 'bru dang lo tog mgon mdzad tshe// sku mdog sngon po 'ja' ltar 'tsher// chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon po bcibs// phyag na 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// 'brug sgrog char 'beb 'bru rnams skyed// bang mdzod 'bru yi 'phel g.yang dang*// dngos grub rgya chen 'dzad med stsol// rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub byin// nor phyugs rta drel mgon mdzad tshe// sku mdog ut+pal ljang gu 'dra// chu glang dkar po chibs su 'chib// sprin phung 'dzin nas char chen 'beb// rtsi thog bskyed cing nor phyugs skyong*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub dang*// phywa g.yang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// nad pa gso ba'i mgon mdzad tshe// sku mdog dmar bkra 'od zer 'bar// chu rta rngog sngon chibs su 'chib// phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis nad rnams bkru// klu nad mdze rigs sos par mdzad// byang chub sems dpa' klu yi gzugs// mi mgon dkar po 'khor bcas la// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod la// mdze rigs dreg grum bad kan rigs// rkang 'bam dmu chu mkhal nad sogs// nad rnams thams cad zhi bar mdzod// nad med bde ba'i dngos grub stsol/

khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i tshe// myur mgyogs chu rta sngon po 'chib// phyag g.yas sba lcag klad la bskor// g.yon pas gwa 'u thugs kar 'dzin// snang srid bdag gi dbang du sdus// sdang ba'i dgra la dmag 'dren tshe// gser mdog sku la bse khrab gsol// rta dkar g.yu rngog chibs su 'chib// phyag g.yas mdung dar dkar po phyar// 'khor gsum bskor zhing gnyan dmag sdud// rdo rje 'od dkar zhes kyang bya// ldom ldom rā tsa zhes kyang bya// rdo rje klu rgod ces kyang bya// sprul pas nam mkha' bar snang gang*// sprul pas sa gzhi sa 'og gang*// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// sdang dgra gnod byed cham la phob// stobs dang 'byor pa rgyas pa yi// g.yang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// klu yi mgon po dkar po yi// blon po klu rgyal dung skyong ni// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu ste// g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog /sbrul mgo lnga yi gdengs ka can// sku smad gdug pa sbrul du 'khyil// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// yid la ci bsam ci smon pa// thams cad khyod kyis 'grub par mdzod// klu yi mgon po dkar po yi// btsun mo klu mo 'od ldan ma// gser mdog mdzes sdug 'dzum pa la// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis bklubs// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang*// g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog /sbrul mgo lnga yi gdengs ka can// dar zab na bza' rab tu bklubs// bzhengs stabs sbrul mjug rked la dkris// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// ci 'dod dngos grub khyod la yod// de rnams bdag la myur du stsol// klu yi mgon po dkar po yi// bka' 'khor klu chen brgyad po rnams// sku stod lha bu'i cha lugs la// sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can// nor bu'i gtsug phud rin chen brgyan// thal sbyar gter gyi bum pa 'dzin// sku smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil// btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas// rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs// dmangs rigs gdol pa 'khor dang bcas// gsol lo mchod do mnyes gyur cig

/klu nad thams cad zhi ba dang*// klu g.yang mi la dbab tu gsol// klu yi mgon po dkar po yi// sras ni klu phrug brgya rtsa brgyad/ khye'u chung brgya dang rtsa brgyad de// res 'ga' chu rta brgya rtsar sprul// res 'ga' gser nya brgya rtsar sprul// res 'ga' dug sbrul brgya rtsar sprul// gsol lo mchod do mnyes gyur cig /yab yum blon 'bangs sras bcas kyis// bdag la sid+dhi myur du stsol// gal te myur du ma stsol na// sngon gyi khas blangs dam las 'gal// rdo rje gtum po thugs khros nas// sprul pa'i khro bo bya khyung dang*// me tshan bye tshan 'jigs pa 'byung*// de bas myur du dngos grub stsol// oṃ phe la hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga 'dus/ nā ga dhu/ nā ga sarba/ he long he long*/ nā ga 'dus 'dus/ shān+tiṃ 'dus/ puṣ+ṭiṃ 'dus/ nā ga dhe wa sarba sid+dhi sa ma ya/ nā ga 'dus 'dus/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bang ba la 'dus/ puṣ+ṭiṃ tshe dang bsod nams la sid+dhi hūm̐/

zhes pa rgya gar khrag 'thung nag pos mdzad pa'i sgrub sngags dang*/ oṃ spu tse spu tse nā ga spu tse/ spu ta spu ta nā ga spu ta/ phi shang phi shang nā ga phi shang*/ nā ga sid+dhi 'ub 'ub/ rug rug sid+dhi sdus sdus hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga le nā ga le/ nā ga dung dung nā ga sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ nā ga pra ti rā dza sa ma ya sid+dhi 'dus 'dus/ zhes 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub sngags so// de rnams cung zad re bzlas te/ rgyun du gtso bo gnam chos gzhung gi sngags bzla 'o// de ltar rgyun du'am dus bzang la gsol kha bya/ sgrub dus kyang gsol kha gal che ste/ 'jig rten mchod dang bstod pas 'grub// ces gsungs/ yang dgra bgegs sogs la rbad na/ dmar gtor la dgug gzhug bya ste/ ngo bo dgra bgegs sha khrag la rnam pa bdud rtsir bsam la 'bul/ hūm̐/ klu yi mgon po dkar po ni// drag po'i las la bskul ba'i tshe// ye shes klu bdud mgo dgu pa// klu srin nā ga rak+sha ste// sku mdog dug chen ha la'i mdog /zhal gdangs spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs// sbrul mgo brgyad ni bar snang 'phyo// sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil ba yis// chu g.yag rog po ri tsam 'chib// sdom sdig sbal sbrul char du 'beb// me 'bar rlung 'tshubs ser sprin phyur// res 'ga' zhal gcig phyag gnyis te// res 'ga' phyag ni bcu drug la// res 'ga' phyag ni nyis brgyar ldan// g.yas kun gri gug dgra srog gcod// g.yon kun sbrul zhags dgra bo 'ching*// gtad khram nag po'i gnyer kha 'dzin// bstan dang bdag la sdang ba yi// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// gsang this nag po'i khram la thobs// gri gug gtubs la sbrul zhags chings// chu g.yag nag pos rdung du chugs// las mkhan nag po ti pa tsa// chu srin 'bar ba'i gre bar brubs// klu nad sna tshogs dgra la thongs// klu yi mgon po'i dus la bab// ldom ldom rā tsa'i dus la bab// rdo rje klu rgod rtsal ma zhan// nag po dpal mdangs mthu ma chung*// 'khor dang yang 'khor bang ma bul// da lta nyid du sgrol la shog
